sources.entry: Titra - Time-tracking solution for freelancers and small teams. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Javascript/Docker

summary.one_liner: Titra is an open source, web-based project time tracker aimed at freelancers and small teams.
summary.what_it_does: Titra is a time-tracking application for project work, positioned as a simple tool for freelancers and small teams. The README emphasizes fast task entry, saying a task can be tracked within about 10 seconds of logging in. It also states that users can report on and export tracked time. A dark mode is mentioned. The project can be run locally with Docker Compose, which starts Titra alongside a MongoDB instance. A hosted version is offered at app.titra.io, and the README mentions a one-click DigitalOcean Marketplace deployment. The README suggests Wekan as a companion tool for planning tasks and includes a wiki for integrating with external tools.
use_cases: track time spent on client projects
pair time tracking with Wekan task planning
notable: Designed for fast task tracking, with a stated goal of under 10 seconds from login to a tracked task
Docker Compose one-liner that starts Titra with a local MongoDB instance
Hosted free version available at app.titra.io
Dark mode and a wiki covering integrations such as Wekan
caveats: The README's Docker command is incomplete (the curl source is missing) and requires setting ROOT_URL
The README does not describe a feature list in detail; the wiki is referenced for setup and best practices
Hosted version is provided free of charge at app.titra.io; self-hosting requires running MongoDB
